notes: Post-hoc execution diagnosis using three completed source trajectories: stable success, early release failure, transient success.
Freeze saved world/source pose and opening references; never re-anchor saved deltas to counterfactual measured state.
Freeze arm algorithm, gains and limits, with causal feedback from each counterfactual environment; numerical arm commands can differ.
No model query, expert future or task-conditioned reference repair. Replay outcomes are not new closed-loop WAM task results.
Require original intent mode to reproduce commands, state, object positions, contacts and task predicates before alternatives.
Latch thresholds are inherited from prior configs; latch changes both closing and release, so it measures total gripper-policy effect.
